title: More of the Same: Persistent Representational Harms Under Increased Representation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating distribution-level representational differences in text generated for various occupations without explicitly prompting for gender. The method infers the gender of the generated text using pronouns and honorifics, extracts statistically significant descriptive words using a Calibrated Marked Words method, and calculates a Subset Representational Bias (SRB) Score using the Chamfer distance between word embeddings of implicitly associated genders and explicitly prompted genders.
